desc: Transforming tactical mobility and precision for the most discreet scenarios, the MRAD Covert breaks new ground by disassembling effortlessly to fit within a bag or backpack, enabling exceptional concealment and rapid transport. Further expanding the renowned MRAD platform with enhanced compactness, adaptability, and mobility, this modular platform continues to advance the frontiers of accuracy and versatility for military operators, law enforcement teams, and long-range enthusiasts.
